comparison.objective: Start an M10 tap using both handles, turn it a quarter turn, then reverse a tenth turn to break the chip.
comparison.physical_skill: Symmetric bimanual torque and axial-force regulation; lateral loading can snap the tap, but no separately swung impact tool is used.
comparison.success_condition: Complete the specified forward and reverse rotations without breaking the tap. Detailed numeric load thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: This is sustained two-handed rotary cutting and reversal. The candidate instead tests coaxial support during discrete hammer impacts, intentional notch fracture, withdrawal, and fragment recovery.
